sources.quote:
Students should form groups of up to five members, with each group tasked with designing 
the air conditioning layout for an open-plan office on a typical floor. The architectural layout 
plan for this floor is provided. It is assumed that a variable air volume (VAV) system will be 
utilized in the design.
1. Space air diffusion design for maximum load condition

• Calculate the cooling load of the open plan office using rule of thumb. 
• Determine the total supply air flow rate of the office. 
• Distribute supply air diffusers on the layout plan. 
• Calculate the supply air flow rate of each diffuser. 
• Find out the characteristic room length, L. 
• Refer to the performance data of KRUEGER “Louvered Face Diffusers 1400, 51400 
Series 4-cone”, and select a suitable type of diffuser. 
• From the diffuser performance data, find the corresponding T0.25. 
• Calculate T0.25 / L. 
• Check if it meets the ASHRAE ADPI requirement.

sources.quote:
Students should form groups of up to five members, with each group tasked with designing 
the air conditioning layout for an open-plan office on a typical floor. The architectural layout 
plan for this floor is provided. It is assumed that a variable air volume (VAV) system will be 
utilized in the design.
3. Single-line diagram of AC layout plan

• Use single lines to sketch the air duct layout for distribution of supply air to all supply 
air diffusers in the office. 
• Use VAV boxes with four to five outlets, but limit the flexible duct length (from the 
VAV box to the diffuser) to be within 5 m. 
• Use straight ductwork as far as possible. 
• Minimize bends and turns. 
• Plan branch ducts to extend from the main trunk to distribute air evenly throughout 
the space.

sources.quote: 4. Sizing of supply air ducts

• Determine the size of the main air ducts and each section of the branch air ducts.  
• The air duct size should satisfy the requirements of maximum air velocity and 
limiting air-pressure drops. 
• Use the Friction Chart in ASHRAE Fundamentals or Online Ductular.  
• The maximum aspect ratio of rectangular air duct is preferred to be 4:1. 
• Label each section of the air duct and tabulate the air duct sizing calculation in a table. 
• The following table for air duct sizing is suggested for your use.
